description.text: A medium close view holds steady on a rain-streaked bus window at night, the glass filling most of the vertical frame. Cold city light from outside presses through the wet pane while faint interior reflections ghost across its surface. Droplets bead along the upper glass and gather into heavier drops; each one trembles, merges with a neighbour, then drags a slow crooked track downward. Beyond the window, smeared headlights, shopfront colour and passing streetlamps slide laterally in soft bands, their shapes stretched by the water. The bus interior stays dark and muffled around the glass, keeping the rain and the moving city as the only visible motion.
Rain ticks and drags against the glass while a low, muffled bus-interior hum sits underneath and distant tyres hiss on the wet road.
At the centre of the pane, droplets bead and cling; beyond them, city lights smear into soft lateral streaks.
A larger drop trembles, merges with a smaller bead and begins a slow crooked descent, clearing a thin trail through the condensation.
Reflections of the dim bus interior ghost across the wet glass as headlights and shopfront colour slide past outside.
More droplets join the running track, gathering into beads that hesitate and then slide faster down the lower pane.

The view tightens toward the glass so individual rivulets and their clinging beads become distinct, revealing clear lenses of water and thin branching trails. Out-of-focus streetlights and shopfront colour continue travelling behind them, sliding from one edge to the other as the bus moves. New drops land, wobble and release, feeding the tracks already running down the pane; small beads cling in place until they are heavy enough to break away. Reflections of the bus interior thin at the edges of the frame, leaving the rain, the glass and the blurred nocturnal city in close detail. The push-in is slow and small in amplitude, gradually resolving the water texture without losing the window's surface.
Individual rivulets resolve as the glass fills the close view, their clinging beads distinct against blurred passing light.
Rain continues tapping and dragging on the pane, the interior hum steady beneath it, with wet-road tyre hiss passing in and out.
A fresh drop lands near the top of the frame, wobbles, merges and releases a thin rivulet that cuts across the older trails.
Streetlights flare into soft elongated bands beyond the water, while tiny beads at the pane's edge catch points of cold colour.
The nearest droplets lose their grip and drag downward in quick, irregular strokes as the blurred city colour keeps sliding past.

soundscape: Rain ticks and drags on the glass, underlaid by a low muffled bus-interior hum and distant tyre hiss on the wet road.

summary.text: A rain-streaked bus window at night, with droplets gathering and sliding as blurred city lights travel past outside.

claims.text: Rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside.
A low, muffled bus-interior hum is present beneath the rain.
Droplets bead, tremble, merge and drag slow crooked tracks down the glass.
Faint interior reflections ghost across the wet window surface.
Distant tyres hiss on the wet road outside the bus.
